I am an old woman of 65 years, and I have farmed this land for many years. My plot is small, only a little less than one hectare for maize, and I intercrop with beans and pepper as my mother taught me. I will buy a small bag of urea and NPK from the market if the price is not too high, because without it the maize will not give good cobs on this tired soil. I keep some goats and chickens, so I spread their droppings on the plot before the rains. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year, so I save my own seed from last harvest, and my sons and grandchildren help me weed since I am too old to do all the work alone.
